page.overview:
Who is Jack Ensley?

Jack Ensley (born 17 October 1906 and died 13 January 1972) was an American businessman and sports car driver active in the 1950s and 1960s. In 1958 and 1959, he tried unsuccessfully to qualify a car at the Indianapolis 500.

He regularly competed in various sports car championships, including the SCCA National Sports Car Championship. He retired from racing in 1969. He died of cancer a few years later, at the age of 65.
